fixed.summary: A store at its cap is a tile with a gold rim and the Full tag, as it was before the TSX port; the tile had taken the tag's gold fill and caps, which left its name, amount and rate unreadable on gold in every pack.
The Driving tag is the accent chip only where the pack draws no chip art; on a pack's chip art it takes the art's ink like the other tags, so it reads (it was dark text on dark art).
A worn-out tyre's figure is in the theme's danger ink, which reads on the packs' chip art; the foe ink it used fell under 4.5:1 there.
A resource's cap, its rate without a trend and the empty line are in the theme's muted ink instead of the body ink at 80% opacity, so they keep 4.5:1 in the light scheme.
